SnapVault
An offline scanner that turns phone photos and image PDFs into clean, searchable documents, then keeps them in a research library. Desktop app at 1440x900, minimum width 1280.

Design notes
Type
Manrope for headings, Instrument Sans for body, Fragment Mono for page counts, dates and tags - the archival voice.
Colour
Cool neutral ground with ink text and a single action blue. Status colour always sits beside an icon and a word.
Surface
8px / 12px / 16px radii; pills only for tags and status. One soft shadow for overlays and stacked pages.
Reading first
Preview is the largest region; metadata stays in a quiet sidebar. Advanced corrections hide behind one toggle.
Library, not a file manager
Search matches title, full text and tags, and every result says where it matched. Reveal in Explorer stays one click away.
